Voice calls.

- Tap 📞 in a direct chat to **call** someone. Calls are end-to-end encrypted and go over Bluetooth only: no internet, no phone number. The other phone rings (following silent/vibrate mode) and can answer from the app or the notification.
- Mute, speaker, a call timer and a quality indicator. The call screen can shrink to a pill so you can keep chatting, calls keep going with the screen off, and missed calls and call durations appear in the chat.
- Voice uses AMR-NB at 7.95 kbit/s (phone-call quality). Calls work best **directly between two phones in range**; through one or two relaying phones they work but can break up. Expect about half a second of delay.
- Murmur asks for the microphone the first time you call or answer.
- Fix: messages sent with "Short" reach no longer show too many hops.

**Compatibility:** both phones need 1.2 or newer to call. Calling an older phone rings out as "No answer".

---

**Install:** download **`Murmur-v1.2.0.apk`** below and open it on your phone (allow "install unknown apps" if Android asks). `Murmur-v1.2.0-debug.apk` is the debug build: same app, slower animations. Both are signed with the same key, so newer versions install over older ones and keep your chats.
